//: Timeout-margin policy registry for *.integration.test.ts explicit vitest timeout overrides. Enforced by src/test-support/integration-timeout-policy.test.ts via the AST scanner in integration-timeout-scan.ts. Fail closed: any override not listed here breaks the policy test. "measured" entries must clear minHeadroomRatio x measuredBaselineMs; "inherited" entries are pre-policy overrides pinned as measurement debt (measuredBaselineMs=null).

policy.description: Every explicit per-test/per-hook timeout override in an integration test must be registered. A measured override must provide a measuredBaselineMs (the worst-case runtime it guards) and set timeoutMs to at least minHeadroomRatio times that baseline. Inherited overrides predate the policy: they are pinned to their exact value (measuredBaselineMs=null) so any edit forces a registry update and a real measurement. New or changed overrides should be registered as measured.
